name: Del Mar
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Del Mar, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Del Mar, CA: Coastal Christmas lights at the fairgrounds, North Pole by the Sea in the Village, Santa photos and the tree lighting.
lede: Del Mar swaps snow for ocean sunsets: one big Village afternoon with Santa, letters to the North Pole and a tree lighting, plus Coastal Christmas lights at the fairgrounds.
celebrates: The Del Mar Village Association packs the season into one December Sunday. North Pole by the Sea fills the Village with letters to Santa, a VW bus photo station, holiday characters, kids' arts and crafts and carolers. The same afternoon, Winter Taste and Sip brings photos with Santa at Del Mar Plaza, and the day ends with the annual tree lighting at the Jim Watkins Amphitheater at L'Auberge Del Mar, with hot chocolate. L'Auberge also keeps a Letters to Santa station in its lobby all December. At the Del Mar Fairgrounds, Coastal Christmas adds a holiday light trail, skating and Santa photos on select nights.
lastyear: In 2025 Del Mar Plaza turned its ocean view deck into a Santa stop on Sunday, December 7, from 1 to 5 pm. The Plaza's own post promised music, photos with Santa and letters to the North Pole, and said tickets were still available on its website two days before. The Del Mar Village Association says its December Winter Taste and Sip day, which includes Santa photos at the Plaza and ends with the downtown tree lighting at L'Auberge Del Mar, draws over 2,000 guests.
facts: Del Mar got its name from a poem. Ella Loop, whose husband Theodore was a railroad official, named the spot after Bayard Taylor's poem The Fight of Paso del Mar. In 1885 Jacob Taylor bought 338 acres to build a seaside resort. The first San Diego County Fair in Del Mar was held in 1936, and Bing Crosby helped open the Del Mar racetrack the next year, giving the town its slogan, where the turf meets the surf. Del Mar became a city in 1959.
trains: Trains made Del Mar. The town grew along the California Southern Railroad, and its depot served passengers from about 1910 until 1995. That year the stop moved two miles north to the Solana Beach station, where Pacific Surfliner and COASTER trains stop today. The old Del Mar station still stands beside the tracks, which run along the bluffs about 40 feet above the beach. In December the COASTER Holiday Express runs from Oceanside to Solana Beach and back, a holiday train that rolls right into the station that replaced Del Mar's depot.

kidfact: Del Mar means of the sea in Spanish. A woman named Ella Loop picked the name from a poem called The Fight of Paso del Mar.
faq: What is North Pole by the Sea in Del Mar?

It is the Del Mar Village Association's family afternoon in December. Kids can write letters to Santa, pose at a VW bus photo station, make arts and crafts and meet holiday characters while carolers stroll the Village. It runs on the same day as the downtown tree lighting at L'Auberge Del Mar, so many families stay into the evening.
Where is the Del Mar tree lighting?

At the Jim Watkins Amphitheater at L'Auberge Del Mar, 1540 Camino Del Mar. The Del Mar Village Association lights the downtown tree there at the end of its big December Sunday, with hot chocolate, holiday characters and music. It caps a day that also includes North Pole by the Sea and Santa photos at Del Mar Plaza.
What is Coastal Christmas at the Del Mar Fairgrounds?

Coastal Christmas is a holiday light festival at the Del Mar Fairgrounds on Jimmy Durante Boulevard. General admission covers a holiday light trail, photos with Santa and friends and live entertainment, while ice skating, a kids' fun zone and food cost extra. It runs on select nights in December, and tickets are sold online.
Is there a train station in Del Mar?

Not anymore. The Del Mar depot closed in 1995, and trains now stop two miles north at the Solana Beach station on North Cedros Avenue, served by the Pacific Surfliner and the COASTER. The old Del Mar depot still stands next to the tracks and is often rented for weddings and events.
